thread:
nina: Hey team — ran into a gnarly bug with the AsyncClient and tool/function calling. When a tool returns both a `tool_output` string and a `structured` object the SDK sometimes yields the parsed structured result twice, which caused our webhook tool to run side-effecting work two times. Anyone seen this?

tor: I have. Saw it yesterday in e2e tests. Repro is intermittent and seems tied to retries + async parsing ordering.

kevin: Minimal repro (async + dataclass) I used:
```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass
class Res:
    op: str
    n: int

c = AsyncClient(api_key='x')

async def run():
    r = await c.generate(
        model='open-infer-1',
        prompt='call math',
        tool_call={'name':'math','args_schema':Res},
    )
    print(r.output)
```
Sometimes prints the parsed Res twice in the list.

nina: We captured a raw payload where runtime included both fields:
```json
{"id":"g1","choices":[{"type":"tool_call","tool":"math","tool_output":"{\"op\":\"add\",\"n\":2}","structured":{"op":"add","n":2}}]}
```

tor: That payload itself is fine; the bug is in the client: the async parse path can race with the retry handler. If the webhook returns 500 then 200, the SDK retries the request and parsing logic can run twice for the same choice, re-adding the parsed object.

kevin: Workarounds we tested: 1) use sync client, 2) set tool_call_parse=False and parse deterministicly yourself, or 3) ensure webhooks are idempotent (idempotency header). Not ideal but blocks production breakage.

nina: Filed ISSUE-4291 with logs and a tiny CI repro.

doc-bot: ISSUE-4291: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/4291 — "AsyncClient: duplicate structured parse on tool_call when retry triggers"

tor: Proposed fix: make parsing of choices atomic in the async path (attach a parsed flag or mutex per choice) and make the retry handler avoid re-parsing already-parsed responses. Also include an integration test that stubs tool webhook to return 500 then 200 to exercise the race.

kevin: Also flagged DX item: type hints for `tool_call.args_schema` are awkward (Union of TypedDict/dataclass/Model). Can we add overloads or generic helpers so editors show correct completions for TypedDict/dataclass/pydantic? Filed DX-203.

nina: CI surfaced a failing test in the integration suite when I tried to reproduce locally.

ci-bot: CI: integration/test_toolcall_async_retry failed on linux-py3.11 — https://ci.redwood.example/runs/6023 :x:

tor: I'm working on a small patch that introduces a per-choice asyncio.Lock and a parsed sentinel; will add unit + integration tests and a changelog entry noting the async duplicate-exec edge case. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/3421

kevin: Tested tor's branch locally — the duplicate parse goes away and the Typed dataclass instance appears only once. Confirmed with our webhook integration harness.

nina: Follow-ups: 1) ship patch release, 2) add docs for `tool_call_parse` opt-out and sample showing TypedDict/dataclass/pydantic examples in async sample app, 3) recommend idempotency tokens for webhook tools to protect side effects, 4) improve type stubs so mypy and editors behave better.

tor: Will add the overloads in a follow-up PR and a small example in devdocs.

nina: Thanks all. Holding off activating any new webhook tooling in prod until the patch ships. Ping here if you want to validate the release candidate. :thumbsup:
